purpose.objective: Apply and verify one Git/GitHub-native Ontology-driven common Harness and native WSL2 Codex/VPS Hermes consumption across the evidence-discovered related portfolio, while completing the existing Academy product and operational backlog in an independent private runtime. Preserve native owners, logical identities, originals, recovery and the absolute read-only Academy source boundary; close only with separate evidence-based Lead Acceptance.
successCriteria: The same logical Domain/Project/Work/Task identities survive source revisions and host/native occurrences; ordinary dependent work reuses suitable Tasks and independently reviewable work has separate Tasks without manual duplicate registration.

Current original user answers, their actual selection context, original owner provenance and predecessor decisions/effects remain source-addressable; historical source milestones and pending/uncertain runtime effects are not rewritten or replayed.

A measured source/import/profile/process/service/data-owner topology covers the actual related WSL2/VPS portfolio and all named Academy/math/profile sources; adopted integration, separation and retirement decisions follow code and dependency evidence, with verified recovery and private publication.

The accepted single common/Codex/Hermes Harness-source repository contains canonical typed modules and related Git Work; domain projects retain domain meaning and native/data/evidence owners. No second agent loop, scheduler, session store, credential bridge or manual identity administration engine is introduced.

Both native runtimes demonstrably use current common contracts, relevant official Runtime Index routes, bounded purpose/decision/history context, native tools and identity-linked execution. Native verification precedes explicit activation; merge/pull alone never counts as activation.

One useful small real Harness task proves Lead-to-worker delegation, WSL2/VPS handoff, interruption/resume, topic Memory original Q/A/rationale/revisions, native Kanban/Session fit, compatible concurrent-update reconciliation, durable local/shared audit receipts and actual cross-runtime receiver verification.

VPS currentness and admitted continuation operate without personal-PC uptime. Configured, callable, authenticated, behaviorally verified, locally durable, shared-delivered and formally complete remain distinct observations.

Academy private operational auth/storage, approved actual source reconciliation/import, backup/restore/rollback, hosting boundary, workflow coverage and exact release integrity are implemented and independently verified against the existing seven gates. Missing source/currentness/teacher judgments remain visible, not fabricated or silently accepted.

Academy teacher-centered workflows preserve original assessment/attempt/judgment/clinic/print/distribution/review identities, exact book-edition hierarchy and parent-facing DailyRecord projections. Requested exam/question selection and student knowledge graph behavior is grounded in original accepted requirements and evidence. Source mutation, sending and printing are exercised only in the independent authorized private/local/staging runtime; the existing Academy server remains absolutely read-only.

Each independently deliverable change has appropriate affected checks, exact-head independent review, private GitHub delivery, explicit expected-head Lead merge and readback. Identical-tree review reuse has an explicit independent successor binding and current material/blocking finding state.

The fresh native evaluation suite stays within 48 requests, 2000000 emitted tokens and 8 hours, tracked separately from ordinary engineering and the native Goal. New paid infrastructure/recurring cost remains zero. Historical suites are not renewed or replayed.

Accountable Lead AcceptanceDecision cites the demonstrated integrated/runtime/Academy outcomes independently of source tests, Git delivery and native activation. Human satisfaction and domain teacher judgments remain unobserved unless actually supplied; unresolved required outcomes keep the Goal incomplete.
inScope: Existing integrated common Harness Work and its WSL2/VPS native runtime engineering, verification and explicit activation
